title: Final Battle with Little Peng King
summary: At the Feng Holy Lord's birthday, Ye Fan's plain-looking source stone opens to reveal Divine Source containing an ancient king clan's holy dragon horn worth five million jin, which squares his debt. Jin Chi demands a life-and-death duel, and they sign a pact before the gathered heroes, fighting on Shen Feng Island 800 li away. Jin Chi uses Sky Hawk Seizes the Dragon and the first four moves of the Heavenly Demon Saint-Slaying Art; Ye Fan counters with the Battle Holy Law and a black-hole evolution, tears off Jin Chi's wings and arm, and is still nearly killed by the fourth move after Jin Chi calls down his ancestors' spirits. At the brink of death Ye Fan comprehends the Taiji Divine Diagram and finishes Jin Chi with the Yin-Yang Dividing Line. The Old Peng King steps in to stop the kill and takes his defeated grandson home, and Jin Chi vows to stay in seclusion until he passes the Nine Saint Trials. At the Human World fortress, assassins and other factions plot to kill Ye Fan without openly crossing the Divine King.
